motion_system: Only the approached botanical overlap briefly settles its doubled contour; surrounding growth stays still. Reduced motion uses a static reveal.
color_drift: Restrained movement between lemon, chartreuse and olive at leaf overlaps; lilac remains confined to petals, with no arbitrary pitch-to-color mapping.
glow_behavior: Soft transmitted bloom on creamy leaf crests only, never a halo around an interactive territory.
